nodes.name: PartnerStack Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: PartnerStack partnership, deal, customer and transaction events (direct with ?key=…, or via a signing relay). 12 pinned fictional events.

nodes.name: Verify Signature & Normalize Event
nodes.notes: HMAC (relay) or URL token (direct) · event name normalisation · partner key, program and tier · amounts · idempotency key.

nodes.name: Search Partner Company
nodes.notes: ps_partner_key, or the partner's e-mail domain on partnership events.

nodes.name: Search Customer Company
nodes.notes: Customer domain (deal meta / customer e-mail) or ps_customer_key (transactions).

nodes.name: Search Candidate Deals
nodes.notes: ps_deal_key, or deals associated with the customer company.

nodes.name: Fetch PartnerStack Partnership
nodes.notes: Optional · Vendor API Basic auth (public key : secret key) · partner group → program and tier.

nodes.name: Resolve Attribution
nodes.notes: Program & rate · deal by key / company · stale, duplicate-transaction, conflict and self-referral guards.

nodes.name: Commission & Association Router
nodes.notes: Deal / company / contact / partner updates · estimated commission · deal ↔ partner link.

nodes.name: Apply HubSpot Write
nodes.notes: batch/update (deals, companies, contacts) or v4 batch association create · idempotent, so retries are safe.

nodes.name: Collect Write Results
nodes.notes: Folds responses back per event · ledger write when every write succeeded.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: Keys, IDs, statuses, amounts only · stdout + ring buffer.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-partnerstack-deal-attribution-sync
PartnerStack referral, affiliate and reseller attribution → HubSpot deals, companies and contacts. dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. No HubSpot, PartnerStack or Slack calls until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute *PartnerStack Webhook Trigger* (12 fictional events).
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real lookups, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: attribution writes and Slack alerts go live.

PartnerStack doesn't document webhook signing. See README.md §5.

### Attribution matching
Partner company by ps_partner_key · customer company by domain or ps_customer_key · deal by ps_deal_key, else the company's open (registration) or won (transaction) deal. Ties write nothing.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers or request bodies. Secrets, API keys and Slack URLs are redacted.

json.sandboxFixture: EXPECT partnership_created (underscore form) · URL token · partner company found by e-mail domain → ps_partner_key, referral silver, active
EXPECT deal registration (no event field, ?event=deal.created) · gold reseller via PartnerStack API group · single open deal → attributed, pending · partner link
EXPECT HMAC relay · deal key match · Closed Won → eligible, 52,000 × 15% = 7,800 · partner win alert
EXPECT stale_event (older than ps_last_event_at) · nothing written
EXPECT customer.updated · same partner already attributed → contact + company refreshed, no conflict
EXPECT attribution conflict (company + contact already maple-fixture) · first-touch keeps existing partner · alert
EXPECT transaction $1,200 (cents) · company by ps_customer_key · won deal · affiliate 25% → +300 accrued (150 → 450), revenue 600 → 1,800
EXPECT transaction_already_applied (key matches ps_last_transaction_key) · nothing written
EXPECT ambiguous (2 open deals, equal score) · nothing written · alert
EXPECT self_referral_suspected (customer domain = partner domain) · no attribution · alert
